trailhead.label: Waalweg entrance at Oberplars by the Kneipp station, bus stop Abzweigung Oberplars (official start)

waypoints.label: Drinking fountain at the Kneipp station

cautions: This package has not yet had a dated field review; check signs on the ground.
The open irrigation channel runs right beside the path.
A suspension footbridge at the Gratsch end (km 4.3).
Orchards and vineyards on both sides, where dogs are not allowed in the growing season.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Local lead rules and temporary closures can change.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
